newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks lower in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks lower in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were lower in early Friday morning trade, following a sharp drop in the New York stock market overnight. But brokers said the Nikkei average might be supported below 20,300 because of firm investor demand.
The key Nikkei 225 average lost 246.66 points or 1.20 percent to 20,254.54 in the first 15 minutes of trading. Its March futures were 240 points lower at 20,300.
Brokers also said the market was awaiting a settlement price for the Nikkei's December futures and options, or special quotations.
